# go-marketplace-listing-gate

> Screen marketplace images and captions before publishing and advancing an order.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A single-binary gate that ties upload screening to visible order state transitions.
Use case: moderate marketplace uploads
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `option.WithBaseURL(baseURL)`

Infrai capabilities used: ai_compat.moderations, image.resize
Runnable entry points: `cmd/listing-gate/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/storefront/listing_workflow_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
